description: The file defines an in-memory, volatile implementation of the IStateMachineStorage interface, including classes VolatileStateMachineStorageProvider and VolatileStateMachineStorage, used for non-durable state storage in Orleans applications. It provides methods for reading, appending, replacing, and deleting log segments, primarily for development/testing scenarios.

classes.name: VolatileStateMachineStorageProvider
classes.description: Provides creation of in-memory, volatile state machine storage instances associated with grain IDs.

classes.name: VolatileStateMachineStorage
classes.description: Implements in-memory storage of log segments; supports reading, appending, replacing, and deleting segments for testing or development.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a VolatileStateMachineStorage instance for the given grain context.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads stored log segments and yields them as LogExtent objects.

methods.name: AppendAsync
methods.description: Appends a new log segment to the in-memory storage.

methods.name: ReplaceAsync
methods.description: Replaces current segments with a new snapshot segment.
